overview: AttriCtrl introduces a lightweight, plug-and-play framework for continuous and fine-grained control over semantic aesthetic attribute intensities (e.g., brightness, detail, realism, safety) in diffusion models by quantifying attributes onto a normalized scale and injecting them via a trainable value encoder while keeping the base model frozen.

modules.name: Attribute Quantification Engine
modules.description: Implements the hybrid strategy for computing raw attribute intensity values, including direct estimation for concrete attributes (Brightness via HSV Value channel mean, Detail via Shannon entropy of grayscale histogram) and similarity-based estimation for abstract attributes (Realism and Safety via CLIP cosine similarity between image embeddings and carefully crafted positive/negative textual prompts).

modules.name: Data Curation and Normalization Module
modules.description: Processes the raw attribute values by dividing the empirical range into equal-width bins, applying balanced sampling strategies (oversampling underrepresented bins, downsampling overrepresented ones), and performing rank-based normalization to map raw values onto a unified [0, 1] scale for consistent multi-attribute control.

modules.name: Custom Dataset and DataLoader
modules.description: Constructs the PyTorch Dataset and DataLoader to yield image-text-attribute tuples, handling image transformations, text tokenization, and the pairing of normalized scalar attribute values with their corresponding images for the training and validation splits.

modules.name: Value Encoder Architecture
modules.description: Implements the lightweight plug-and-play module that transforms a normalized scalar intensity value into a sequence of learnable tokens. It applies sinusoidal embedding, passes through an MLP with SiLU activation, duplicates the representation into a fixed-length token sequence, and adds learnable positional embeddings.

modules.name: Diffusion Model Integration Module
modules.description: Integrates the Value Encoder with the base Diffusion Transformer (DiT) architecture by concatenating the output token sequence from the Value Encoder with the text prompt embeddings along the sequence dimension, ensuring the base model weights remain frozen during training.

modules.name: Training Pipeline
modules.description: Manages the training loop for optimizing the Value Encoder parameters using the standard diffusion denoising objective. It handles forward passes through the frozen base model and the trainable encoder, computes the noise prediction loss, and performs gradient updates while maintaining the frozen state of the base model.

modules.name: Multi-Attribute Composition Module
modules.description: Implements the modular inference strategy for controlling multiple aesthetic attributes simultaneously by independently encoding multiple scalar intensity values using their respective trained Value Encoders and concatenating all resulting token sequences with the text embedding before feeding them into the diffusion model.

modules.name: Controllable Inference Pipeline
modules.description: Executes the denoising/sampling loop to generate images conditioned on both text prompts and user-specified attribute intensity values, supporting single and multi-attribute control as well as compatibility with existing frameworks like ControlNet.

modules.name: Control Accuracy Evaluation Module
modules.description: Calculates the control accuracy metric (AvgDiff) by generating images with target attribute intensities, extracting and normalizing the actual attribute values from the generated images using the quantification and normalization modules, and computing the average absolute difference between target and result values.

modules.name: Safety and Unrelated Concept Evaluation
modules.description: Evaluates the safety control performance by computing the Removal Rate (RR) of inappropriate content on the I2P dataset, and assesses the impact on unrelated concepts by calculating FID and CLIP Score on the COCO-10K dataset to ensure general generation quality is preserved.

modules.name: Ablation Study Framework
modules.description: Provides scripts to systematically evaluate architectural design choices of the Value Encoder, specifically conducting controlled experiments varying the token sequence length and the inclusion/exclusion of positional embeddings, and measuring their impact on control accuracy.

modules.name: Visualization and User Study Toolkit
modules.description: Generates qualitative grids and image sequences showing smooth transitions across attribute intensities for visual assessment, and formats comparison pairs/sequences for baseline methods to support double-blind user preference studies evaluating perceptual quality and control smoothness.
